summary: The interface fits within the 320x480 viewport and presents a clean layout, with minor spacing and text-wrapping issues across the command and item lists.

issues.title: Cramped bottom padding
issues.description: The list container lacks adequate bottom spacing below the final entry.
issues.evidence: The 'Full color' row sits directly flush against the bottom container border.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent bottom padding to the command list container.

issues.title: Awkward description wrapping
issues.description: Item metadata wraps prematurely leaving trailing punctuation.
issues.evidence: The description under 'Scalp treatment' breaks into '+15 min ·' and '$20 add-on'.
issues.suggestion: Adjust item content width or text wrapping to prevent orphaned delimiters.
